=== Shift-Down from a cursor selects the item and the next one, whole
--- given
- a
- b‸
  - b1
- c
- d
--- when key Shift-Down
--- then
- a
⟨- b
  - b1
- c⟩
- d

=== Shift-Down again adds the next sibling
--- given
- a
⟨- b
  - b1
- c⟩
- d
--- when key Shift-Down
--- then
- a
⟨- b
  - b1
- c
- d⟩

=== Shift-Up shrinks the selection back by one sibling
--- given
- a
⟨- b
  - b1
- c
- d⟩
--- when key Shift-Down
--- then consumed
- a
⟨- b
  - b1
- c
- d⟩

=== Shift-Down at the last sibling swallows the key
--- given
- a
⟨- b
- c⟩
--- when key Shift-Down
--- then consumed
- a
⟨- b
- c⟩

=== Shift-Up from three items selected leaves two
--- given
- a
⟨- b
  - b1
- c
- d⟩
--- when key Shift-Up
--- then
- a
⟨- b
  - b1
- c⟩
- d

=== Shift-Up from two items selected leaves the first alone, still whole
--- given
- a
⟨- b
  - b1
- c⟩
- d
--- when key Shift-Up
--- then
- a
⟨- b
  - b1⟩
- c
- d

=== Shift-Up from one whole item extends upward with the anchor at the end
--- given
- a
⟨- b
  - b1⟩
- c
--- when key Shift-Up
--- then
⟩- a
- b
  - b1⟨
- c

=== Shift-Up from a cursor selects the item and the previous one
--- given
- a
- b‸
- c
--- when key Shift-Up
--- then
⟩- a
- b⟨
- c

=== Shift-Down from an upward selection shrinks it from the top
--- given
⟩- a
- b
  - b1⟨
- c
--- when key Shift-Down
--- then
- a
⟨- b
  - b1⟩
- c

=== Shift-Down from a cursor on the last sibling selects the item alone
--- given
- a
- b‸
  - b1
--- when key Shift-Down
--- then
- a
⟨- b
  - b1⟩

=== Shift-Down from a cursor on a notes line selects the owning item
--- given
- a
  no‸te
- b
--- when key Shift-Down
--- then
⟨- a
  note
- b⟩

=== Shift-Down selects at the child level when the cursor is on a child
--- given
- p
  - q‸
  - r
- s
--- when key Shift-Down
--- then
- p
⟨  - q
  - r⟩
- s

=== Shift-Down with a character selection passes to the editor
--- given
- a⟨b⟩c
- d
--- when key Shift-Down
--- then passthrough
- a⟨b⟩c
- d

=== Shift-Down with a selection that stops mid-item passes to the editor
--- given
⟨- a
- b⟩c
--- when key Shift-Down
--- then passthrough
⟨- a
- b⟩c

=== Shift-Down passes to the editor when switched off
--- given select=off
- a‸
- b
--- when key Shift-Down
--- then passthrough
- a‸
- b

=== Shift-Down outside a list passes to the editor
--- given
para‸graph
- a
--- when key Shift-Down
--- then passthrough
para‸graph
- a

=== Tab with whole items selected indents all of them
--- given
- a
⟨- b
  - b1
- c⟩
- d
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
⟨  - b
    - b1
  - c⟩
- d

=== Tab with whole items selected on the first sibling swallows the key
--- given
⟨- a
- b⟩
- c
--- when key Tab
--- then consumed
⟨- a
- b⟩
- c

=== Shift-Tab with whole items selected outdents all of them
--- given
- p
⟨  - q
  - r⟩
  - s
--- when key Shift-Tab
--- then
- p
  - s
⟨- q
- r⟩

=== Move up with whole items selected moves the run and keeps it selected
--- given
- a
⟨- b
- c
  - c1⟩
--- when command move-up
--- then
⟨- b
- c
  - c1⟩
- a

=== Move down with whole items selected joins the next parent as its first children
--- given
- p
⟨  - q
  - r⟩
- s
  - t
--- when command move-down
--- then
- p
- s
⟨  - q
  - r⟩
  - t

=== Move up with an upward selection keeps the anchor at the end
--- given
- a
⟩- b
- c⟨
--- when command move-up
--- then
⟩- b
- c⟨
- a

=== Tab with one whole item selected indents it with its children
--- given
- a
⟨- b
  - b1⟩
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
⟨  - b
    - b1⟩

=== Enter with whole items selected passes to the editor
--- given
⟨- a
- b⟩
--- when key Enter
--- then passthrough
⟨- a
- b⟩

=== Tab with whole items selected renumbers both groups
--- given
1. a
⟨2. b
3. c⟩
4. d
--- when key Tab
--- then
1. a
⟨  1. b
  2. c⟩
2. d

=== Move down with whole items selected swaps the run past the next sibling
--- given
⟨- a
- b
  - b1⟩
- c
- d
--- when command move-down
--- then
- c
⟨- a
- b
  - b1⟩
- d
